entities.name: Sergio Blažić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sergio Blažić, also known by his nickname Đoser, was a Croatian and Yugoslav rock musician, best known as the lead vocalist of popular hard rock band Atomsko Sklonište. Blažić was the group's frontman since its formation in 1977 until his death of Hodgkin lymphoma in 1987, recording seven studio albums and two live albums with the group.
